title: OpenAI and Gemini on 36 commerce tasks
summary: We tested GPT-6.1 Terra, GPT-6.2 Sol, Gemini 4 Neon and Hydrogen on 36 shopping, returns and support tasks, comparing pass rates, cost and latency with earlier Gemini runs.
